# event observation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:eventObservation`](gmeow-eventObservation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/eventObservation>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)

An observation made during or about an event. Inverse of [`gmeow:observationEvent`](gmeow-observationEvent.md) (observations module). Non-functional: an event may have many observations, and competing standpoint-indexed observations coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
